create_formatter_default: create a DefaultFormatter instance to format instruction-tuned model prompts with role-based structure
create_formatter_concat: create a ConcatFormatter instance to concatenate messages without role-based formatting
test_formatter_format: test the Formatter.format method to convert messages into a formatted ChunkList prompt
test_formatter_is_role_supported: test the Formatter.is_role_supported method to check if a role is supported by the formatter
test_formatter_extra_stop_sequences: test the Formatter.extra_stop_sequences method to retrieve stop sequences for generation
